Engagement and delivery practices

These are the topics we review before work begins. The written project agreement governs the engagement.

Confidentiality and NDAs
Before sharing confidential materials, agree on confidentiality terms, participants and approved channels.
Source code and IP
The proposal specifies the source code, models and documentation to hand over. Licensing for pre-existing tools and third-party components is scoped per engagement.
Data handling and private deployment
Agree on access, data movement and retention for the target environment. Scope private deployment against available hardware, network and permissions.
Acceptance and handoff
Agree on representative test inputs, pass criteria and operating documentation. Acceptance follows the agreed scenarios and measurement scope.
Maintenance and change requests
Agree on support duration, maintenance ownership and how to handle new requirements before handoff.
